solves.reasoning: brain circuits (회로) makes sense, barriers (장벽) does not. confident fits positive context with grateful/relaxed. lasting changes vs temporary - the text discusses permanent neural pathways.
evoke means to call forth/trigger emotions - fits with gratitude. activated (not diminished) fits neurons being turned on. intentionally (not accidentally) - we deliberately create habits.
fundamentally no different - strong comparison. neural pathways (not disorders) - positive development. premise (a starting proposition) fits 'bottom line' that follows.
resentful (원망하는) is negative, contradicts the positive trio of grateful/relaxed/confident. The other three (stronger, shaped, encouraging) all fit their contexts.
lonelier is negative and contradicts the whole message about training the brain for happiness. practice/repeating/develop all fit their original contexts.
restrain means to hold back/limit - opposite of train (to develop skills). relaxation/fire/habits all fit perfectly in context.
through regular ___: practice completes 'regular practice', a common collocation. theory/talent/memory don't collocate with 'regular' in this brain-training context.
grateful, relaxed, or ___: needs a positive quality. Only confident fits. anxious/passive/exhausted are all negative states.
brain is ___ by thoughts: shaped (formed/molded) fits perfectly. limited/damaged/ignored are all negative or illogical.
practice synonym: training (both mean repeated exercise to improve). theory is opposite, talent is innate ability, lecture is passive.
evoke synonym: arouse (to stir up/call forth). prevent/conceal/reduce are all opposite in meaning.
lasting synonym: enduring (continuing for a long time). brief is antonym, sudden/minor are different semantic axes.
encouraging antonym: discouraging (making someone lose motivation). surprising/challenging/interesting are on different semantic axes.
relaxed antonym: tense (physically/mentally tight). grateful/confident are on same positive axis, repeated is unrelated.
(A) neurons fire = send electrical signals (발화). (B) fire employees = dismiss/let go (해고). Option 4 correctly matches both meanings.
a basic idea/belief underlying a theory = premise. habit is behavioral, circuit is physical, pathway is a route.
gratitude, ___ (relax), or confidence - needs noun form parallel to gratitude/confidence. relax → relaxation.
___ (last) changes - needs adjective to modify 'changes'. last → lasting (present participle as adjective).
circuits grow stronger through ___: regular practice fits the scientific context about brain plasticity through repeated exercise.
Neurons that fire together ___: wire together completes Hebb's famous rule about neural connections strengthening through co-activation.
